import hashlib, json, os, signal, subprocess, time
from pathlib import Path

p = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
plan = json.loads((p / 'plan.json').read_text())
dll = p / 'diagnostic-build/CombatSolver.dll'
plan.update(scope='Listener producer type-match coverage; diagnostic instrumentation; no performance acceptance',
            candidateDll=str(dll), candidateDllSha256=hashlib.sha256(dll.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
            sequence=['diagnostic'], diagnostics=True)
root = p / 'diagnostic'
root.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
(root / 'provenance.json').write_text(json.dumps(plan, indent=2) + '\n')
(p / 'diagnostic-source.patch').write_bytes(subprocess.check_output(['git', 'diff', '--', 'CombatSolver.csproj', 'src/Search/SimulatedCombatState.cs']))
(p / 'diagnostic-build-result.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(status='Passed', warnings=1, errors=0, elapsedSeconds=15.44, warningCodes=['CA2255'], dll=str(dll), sha256=plan['candidateDllSha256']), indent=2) + '\n')
for scene in plan['roots']:
    out = root / scene
    out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    env = os.environ.copy()
    for k in list(env):
        if k.startswith(('OFFLINE_HARNESS_', 'COMBATSOLVER_VERIFY', 'DOTNET_Jit', 'COMPlus_Jit')) or k in ('DOTNET_PerfMapEnabled', 'COMBATSOLVER_MEASUREMENT_TRACE', 'LISTENER_PRODUCER_PROBE_OUTPUT'):
            env.pop(k)
    env['OFFLINE_HARNESS_COMBATSOLVER_DLL'] = str(dll)
    env['LISTENER_PRODUCER_PROBE_OUTPUT'] = str(out / 'producer-categories.json')
    args = ['dotnet', plan['host'], '--request', plan['requestDirectory'] + '/' + scene + '.json', '--label', scene + '-producer-type-diagnostic', '--out', str(out), '--profile', 'VeryHigh', '--dop', '16', '--budget-ms', '60000', '--search-mode', 'Evaluate', '--nodes', '25000', '--beam', '135', '--card-branches', '72', '--pile-branches', '42', '--hand-branches', '54', '--enable-no-gc-region', '--no-gc-region-budget-gigabytes', '16']
    (out / 'command.json').write_text(json.dumps(args, indent=2) + '\n')
    begin = time.monotonic()
    with (out / 'launcher.log').open('w') as log:
        child = subprocess.Popen(args, env=env, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, start_new_session=True)
        try:
            code = child.wait(timeout=120)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
            child.wait(timeout=10)
            raise
    if code:
        raise RuntimeError(scene + ' failed: ' + str(code))
    d = json.loads((out / 'result.json').read_text())
    assert d['status'] == 'Passed'
    counters = json.loads((out / 'producer-categories.json').read_text())
    print(json.dumps(dict(scene=scene, processWallSeconds=time.monotonic()-begin, counters=counters)), flush=True)

<Project Sdk="Godot.NET.Sdk/4.5.1">
  <Import Project="./local.props" Condition="Exists('./local.props')" />
  <Import Project="./.local/presence.props" Condition="'$(PresencePropsPath)' == '' and Exists('./.local/presence.props')" />
  <Import Project="$(PresencePropsPath)" Condition="'$(PresencePropsPath)' != ''" />
  <Import Project="./.local/showcase.props" Condition="'$(ShowcasePropsPath)' == '' and Exists('./.local/showcase.props')" />
  <Import Project="$(ShowcasePropsPath)" Condition="'$(ShowcasePropsPath)' != ''" />

  <ItemGroup Condition="'$(PresenceEndpoint)' != ''">
    <AssemblyMetadata Include="PresenceEndpoint" Value="$(PresenceEndpoint)" />
    <AssemblyMetadata Include="PresenceCertificateSha256" Value="$(PresenceCertificateSha256)" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <ItemGroup Condition="'$(ShowcaseEndpoint)' != ''">
    <AssemblyMetadata Include="ShowcaseEndpoint" Value="$(ShowcaseEndpoint)" />
    <AssemblyMetadata Include="ShowcaseUploadToken" Value="$(ShowcaseUploadToken)" />
    <AssemblyMetadata Include="ShowcaseCertificateSha256" Value="$(ShowcaseCertificateSha256)" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <PropertyGroup>
    <TargetFramework>net9.0</TargetFramework>
    <LangVersion>13.0</LangVersion>
    <Nullable>enable</Nullable>
    <ImplicitUsings>true</ImplicitUsings>
    <AllowUnsafeBlocks>true</AllowUnsafeBlocks>
    <EnableDynamicLoading>true</EnableDynamicLoading>
    <RootNamespace>CombatSolver</RootNamespace>
    <Version>0.50.0</Version>
    <DefineConstants Condition="'$(VerifyListenerProducer)' == 'true'">$(DefineConstants);VERIFY_LISTENER_PRODUCER</DefineConstants>
    <DefineConstants Condition="'$(VerifyHistoryCounters)' == 'true'">$(DefineConstants);VERIFY_HISTORY_COUNTERS</DefineConstants>
    <SteamRoot Condition="'$(SteamRoot)' == '' and '$(OS)' == 'Windows_NT' and Exists('D:/Steam')">D:/Steam</SteamRoot>
    <SteamRoot Condition="'$(SteamRoot)' == '' and '$(OS)' == 'Windows_NT'">$(MSBuildProgramFiles32)/Steam</SteamRoot>
    <SteamRoot Condition="'$(SteamRoot)' == ''">$(HOME)/.local/share/Steam</SteamRoot>
    <Sts2Dir Condition="'$(Sts2Dir)' == ''">$(SteamRoot)/steamapps/common/Slay the Spire 2</Sts2Dir>
    <Sts2DataDir Condition="'$(Sts2DataDir)' == '' and '$(OS)' == 'Windows_NT'">$(Sts2Dir)/data_sts2_windows_x86_64</Sts2DataDir>
    <Sts2DataDir Condition="'$(Sts2DataDir)' == ''">$(Sts2Dir)/data_sts2_linuxbsd_x86_64</Sts2DataDir>
    <RitsuWorkshopRoot Condition="'$(RitsuWorkshopRoot)' == ''">$(SteamRoot)/steamapps/workshop/content/2868840/3747602295</RitsuWorkshopRoot>
    <RitsuLibDir Condition="'$(RitsuLibDir)' == ''">$(SteamRoot)/steamapps/workshop/content/2868840/3747602295/lib/0.111.0</RitsuLibDir>
    <RitsuLibReferenceTarget Condition="'$(RitsuLibReferenceTarget)' == ''">0.111.0</RitsuLibReferenceTarget>
    <RitsuLibReferencesProps>$(RitsuWorkshopRoot)/RitsuLib.References.props</RitsuLibReferencesProps>
    <ModOutputDir>$(Sts2Dir)/mods/CombatSolver</ModOutputDir>
    <CopyModOnBuild Condition="'$(CopyModOnBuild)' == ''">true</CopyModOnBuild>
    <NoWarn>$(NoWarn);CS0436</NoWarn>
    <MemoryCleanerProject>$(MSBuildProjectDirectory)/tools/runtime/CombatSolver.MemoryCleaner/CombatSolver.MemoryCleaner.csproj</MemoryCleanerProject>
    <MemoryCleanerOutput>$(MSBuildProjectDirectory)/.local/tool-build/CombatSolver.MemoryCleaner/bin/$(Configuration)/net48/CombatSolver.MemoryCleaner.exe</MemoryCleanerOutput>
  </PropertyGroup>

  <Import Project="$(RitsuLibReferencesProps)" Condition="Exists('$(RitsuLibReferencesProps)')" />

  <ItemGroup>
    <Compile Remove="tools/**/*.cs" />
    <Compile Remove="outputs/**/*.cs" />
    <Compile Remove=".local/**/*.cs" />
    <EmbeddedResource Include="src/UI/English.json" LogicalName="CombatSolver.UI.English.json" />
    <PackageReference Include="Krafs.Publicizer" Version="2.3.0" PrivateAssets="all" />
    <Publicize Include="sts2" IncludeVirtualMembers="false" IncludeCompilerGeneratedMembers="false" />
    <!-- 离线搜索宿主（tools/search/OfflineSearchHarness）走 internal 入口，不对模组自己做公开化。 -->
    <InternalsVisibleTo Include="OfflineSearchHarness" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <ItemGroup Condition="'$(VerifyListenerProducer)' == 'true'">
    <Compile Include=".local/tool-tasks/listener-producer-type-match-20261006/NativeProof.cs" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <Reference Include="sts2" HintPath="$(Sts2DataDir)/sts2.dll" Private="false" />
    <Reference Include="0Harmony" HintPath="$(Sts2DataDir)/0Harmony.dll" Private="false" />
    <Reference Include="GodotSharp" HintPath="$(Sts2DataDir)/GodotSharp.dll" Private="false" />
    <Reference Include="STS2-RitsuLib" HintPath="$(RitsuLibDir)/STS2-RitsuLib.dll" Private="false"
               Condition="!Exists('$(RitsuLibReferencesProps)')" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <Target Name="ValidateSts2GameInstall" BeforeTargets="ResolveAssemblyReferences">
    <Error Condition="!Exists('$(Sts2DataDir)/sts2.dll')" Text="找不到 $(Sts2DataDir)/sts2.dll。请检查 SteamRoot 或 local.props。" />
    <Error Condition="!Exists('$(RitsuLibReferencesProps)') and !Exists('$(RitsuLibDir)/STS2-RitsuLib.dll')"
           Text="找不到当前游戏版本的 RitsuLib。请检查 SteamRoot、RitsuWorkshopRoot 或 local.props。" />
  </Target>

  <Target Name="ValidatePublicationConnections" BeforeTargets="GenerateAssemblyInfo" Condition="'$(PublicationBuild)' == 'true'">
    <Error Condition="'$(PresenceEndpoint)' == ''" Text="发布构建缺少 PresenceEndpoint。" />
    <Error Condition="'$(PresenceCertificateSha256)' == ''" Text="发布构建缺少 PresenceCertificateSha256。" />
    <Error Condition="'$(ShowcaseEndpoint)' == ''" Text="发布构建缺少 ShowcaseEndpoint。" />
    <Error Condition="'$(ShowcaseUploadToken)' == ''" Text="发布构建缺少 ShowcaseUploadToken。" />
    <Error Condition="'$(ShowcaseCertificateSha256)' == ''" Text="发布构建缺少 ShowcaseCertificateSha256。" />
  </Target>

  <Target Name="BuildMemoryCleaner" BeforeTargets="Build" Condition="'$(OS)' == 'Windows_NT'">
    <MSBuild Projects="$(MemoryCleanerProject)" Targets="Restore" Properties="Configuration=$(Configuration)" />
    <MSBuild Projects="$(MemoryCleanerProject)" Targets="Build" Properties="Configuration=$(Configuration)" />
  </Target>

  <Target Name="CleanMemoryCleaner" BeforeTargets="Clean" Condition="'$(OS)' == 'Windows_NT'">
    <MSBuild Projects="$(MemoryCleanerProject)" Targets="Clean" Properties="Configuration=$(Configuration)" />
  </Target>

  <Target Name="CopyMod" AfterTargets="Build" Condition="'$(CopyModOnBuild)' == 'true'">
    <MakeDir Directories="$(ModOutputDir)" />
    <Copy SourceFiles="$(TargetPath)" DestinationFolder="$(ModOutputDir)" />
    <Copy SourceFiles="$(MSBuildProjectDirectory)/CombatSolver.json" DestinationFolder="$(ModOutputDir)" />
    <Copy SourceFiles="$(MemoryCleanerOutput)" DestinationFolder="$(ModOutputDir)" Condition="'$(OS)' == 'Windows_NT'" />
  </Target>
</Project>

sources.replay-ancestry-reference.py.txt:
import bisect, collections, json, re
from pathlib import Path

prior = json.loads(Path('docs/performance/unresolved-roots-cpu-20261006.json').read_text())
results = []
for run in prior['runs']:
    scene = run['scene']
    p = Path(run['rawPerfPath']).parent
    table = {}
    for line in (p / 'managed-perf.map').read_text().splitlines():
        parts = line.split(' ', 2)
        if len(parts) == 3:
            start, length = int(parts[0], 16), int(parts[1], 16)
            table[start] = (start + length, parts[2])
    addresses = sorted(table)
    def resolve(pc):
        index = bisect.bisect_right(addresses, pc) - 1
        if index >= 0:
            end, name = table[addresses[index]]
            if pc < end:
                return name
        return ''
    cpu = run['cpu']
    samples = cycles = 0
    groups = collections.Counter()
    callers = collections.Counter()
    for block in (p / 'frames.txt').read_text().split('\n\n'):
        lines = block.splitlines()
        if not lines:
            continue
        match = re.match(r'^(\d+\.\d+):\s+(\d+)', lines[0])
        if not match:
            raise ValueError(lines[0])
        time, period = float(match[1]), int(match[2])
        if not cpu['startMonotonic'] <= time <= cpu['endMonotonic']:
            continue
        samples += 1
        cycles += period
        names = [resolve(int(line.split()[0], 16)) for line in lines[1:] if line.strip()]
        replay = any(re.search(r'CombatBeamSolver::Replay(?:\[|\(|$)', name) for name in names)
        if not replay:
            continue
        groups['inclusiveReplay'] += period
        if any('ReplayAction' in name for name in names):
            groups['withReplayActionAncestry'] += period
        else:
            groups['withoutResolvedReplayActionAncestry'] += period
            for name in names:
                if 'CombatSolver.CombatBeamSolver' in name and not re.search(r'::Replay(?:\[|\(|$)', name):
                    callers[name] += period
                    break
    assert samples == cpu['includedSamples'], (scene, samples, cpu['includedSamples'])
    assert cycles == cpu['estimatedCycles'], (scene, cycles, cpu['estimatedCycles'])
    result = dict(scene=scene, samples=samples, cycles=cycles,
                  groups={name:dict(cycles=value, percent=100*value/cycles) for name,value in groups.items()},
                  nearestOtherSolverFrames=[dict(frame=name, percent=100*value/cycles) for name,value in callers.most_common(12)])
    results.append(result)
    print(json.dumps(result), flush=True)
output = dict(scope='Same two complete-request CPU windows; inclusive Replay paths overlap Snapshot/Fork. Missing ReplayAction ancestry is not proof of a root replay; inlining and unresolved frames limit interpretation. No timing acceptance or call counts.',
              priorEvidence='docs/performance/unresolved-roots-cpu-20261006.json',
              runtimeBaseline=prior['runtimeBaseline'], sourceCommit=prior['sourceCommit'], results=results)
Path('.local/tool-tasks/power-only-listener-suffix-20261006/replay-ancestry.json').write_text(json.dumps(output,indent=2)+'\n')
